## Verification checklist

- [ ] `flutter analyze` — no issues
- [ ] `dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed .` — clean
- [ ] `flutter test` — all tests pass (incl. golden tests)
- [ ] `dart run build_runner build` — codegen up to date
- [ ] `pubspec.yaml` version bumped (required to merge)
- [ ] Verified on Android and/or iOS where UI changed
- [ ] Docs updated where applicable (README, CHANGELOG)
- [ ] No unrelated changes included in this PR
